name: Emma Ytterell - Article 8, § 1 - Am 117
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 1. Where the plans, projects, works or recurring activities referred to in the first subparagraph result in the deterioration or destruction of breeding sites or resting places of species protected under Directive 92/43/EEC, this shall not be considered as prohibited within the meaning of Article 12(1), point (d), of that Directive, provided that the relevant Member State authority has determined that the plan, project, works or recurring activity includes appropriate and proportionate measures, which may be defined under specific national or regional regimes, to avoid such deterioration or destruction.
